_doc: How the VO chunks are cut into beats and laid on the timeline. Seconds. Read by scripts/yt/vo-build.py.

_notes.tighten: ElevenLabs leaves 0.5-0.9 s between sentences. Every silent gap longer than 0.36 s is cut to 0.3 s, taken from its middle so the breath stays; a laugh or a sigh is never cut (the cut region must be 28 dB under her speech). Protected: the performed pauses (the ellipses at 3, 12, 52 and 60; the [pause] before 8 and 32; the melt at 34).
_notes.extraAfter: Leo, W43: every second counts; air only where the picture needs it. 18: the title transition. 34: one second of silence after 'It starts to melt' (script-deltas #12), the rewind runs inside it. 35: into the product transition. 50: the pass chime. 52: the sweet surprise lands. 61: the second chime.
_notes.silentBeats: 65: the end card holds for YouTube's end screen after the last line
_notes.tempo: Frankie on ElevenLabs v4 reads at about 153 wpm; every take is sped up by 1.05 after tightening, so the film keeps W43's pace (about 161 wpm). With ffmpeg atempo (time-domain): Rubber Band (phase vocoder) made the voice sound robotic (round 3, measured: CPP -17 %, HNR -2.3 dB; atempo -0.4 %, -0.6 dB).
_notes.match: Round 3 (Leo: the voice 'sounds different in different scenarios'): the 14 takes are generated separately, so each one's overall colour and level drift a little. vo-build matches every take onto the median take (EQ at most +-3 dB, 90 Hz-14 kHz, and level).
_notes.studio: Frankie is a full-band studio voice: no bandwidth extension, no AudioSR, no tone EQ; the chain is a 70 Hz high-pass and a light de-esser.
